connector.name: Agentdocs MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for AgentDocs (agentdocs.eu): read, search, write, comment on & share Markdown docs.
connector.summary: Hosted at agentdocs.eu over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agentdocs-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hoornet account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AgentDocs API token, as "Token <api_token>" (account or space-scoped). "Bearer <api_token>" is also accepted. Profile → Regenerate API Token, or Space settings → Tokens.

env.name: AGENTDOCS_TOKEN
env.description: AgentDocs API token (account or space-scoped). Profile → Regenerate API Token, or Space settings → Tokens.

env.name: AGENTDOCS_URL
env.description: Override the AgentDocs API base URL. Advanced — defaults to the hosted service at https://agentdocs.eu; set this only if you have been given a different endpoint.
